entities.summary: "Right by My Side" is a song by rapper Nicki Minaj featuring American singer Chris Brown. It was released on March 27, 2012, by Young Money, Cash Money, and Universal Republic as the second single from Minaj's second album, Pink Friday: Roman Reloaded (2012). The song was written by Ester Dean and Minaj, while production was handled by Pop & Oak.
